package player

// ddsonic contract (Slice B, active tree only: it names the patch's cdnMu, so
// it is never staged against the base). One goroutine and nothing else uses
// this Player, so no other owner can hold or contend cdnMu: inside every
// transport round trip, which is the network work of the CDN loop, a failed
// TryLock could only mean the loop holds the lock across that work.

import (
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	librespot "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot"
	downloadpb "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/proto/spotify/download"
)

type ddsonicProbeRT func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)

func (f ddsonicProbeRT) RoundTrip(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) { return f(req) }

func TestDDSonicContractCDNLockNotHeldAcrossNetwork(t *testing.T) {
	p := &Player{cdnQuarantine: make(map[string]time.Time)}
	var probes, held int
	client := &http.Client{Transport: ddsonicProbeRT(func(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
		probes++
		if p.cdnMu.TryLock() {
			p.cdnMu.Unlock()
		} else {
			held++
		}
		if req.URL.Host == "a.ddsonic.invalid" {
			return nil, errors.New("ddsonic contract: cdn host unavailable")
		}
		return &http.Response{
			StatusCode: http.StatusPartialContent,
			Header:     http.Header{"Content-Range": []string{"bytes 0-0/1"}},
			Body:       io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("x")),
			Request:    req,
		}, nil
	})}
	r, err := p.httpChunkedReaderFromStorageResolve(&librespot.NullLogger{}, client, &downloadpb.StorageResolveResponse{
		Result: downloadpb.StorageResolveResponse_CDN,
		Cdnurl: []string{"https://a.ddsonic.invalid/f", "https://b.ddsonic.invalid/f"},
	})
	if err != nil || r == nil {
		t.Fatalf("the serving host was not reached: %v", err)
	}
	r.Close()
	if probes < 2 {
		t.Fatalf("only %d round trips were probed", probes)
	}
	if held != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("cdnMu was held during %d of %d round trips", held, probes)
	}
	if _, found := p.cdnQuarantine["a.ddsonic.invalid"]; !found || len(p.cdnQuarantine) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("the quarantine is not exactly the failing host: %v", p.cdnQuarantine)
	}
}
